pages.text: Greenhouses combine structure validation, irrigation, farmland preparation, planting, harvesting and optional accelerated growth. Correct material geometry alone does not guarantee that every crop can survive in every position.$p1. Build or assemble the correct greenhouse tier and leave its growing cells available.$p2. Prepare the required dirt/grass underneath the crop positions. Automatic farmland and water placement must be enabled and permitted by protection checks.$p3. Supply seeds compatible with that tier. Basic/Advanced reserve their first four input slots for construction materials; Flawless can use all fourteen inputs for seeds.$p4. Place a chest directly outside the controller for seed import and produce export, or use internal storage. Its side mode must allow the requested direction.$p5. Supply FE and suitable CO₂. Watch for pending output, a disabled side, Pause, or redstone before adding more fuel.$p6. Allow ordinary crop light/survival rules. A greenhouse does not invent a valid harvest contract for an arbitrary third-party plant.$p$(l)Native crop tiers$()$pBroccoli — Can also grow outside a greenhouse.$pPrunae — Requires at least Advanced tier for greenhouse planting.$pFiddledew — Requires Flawless tier.$pGas Lanterns supply CO₂ to Basic and Advanced structures; Flawless uses its correctly positioned CO₂ Generator. Carbon changes growth intervals. Planting, growth, harvest, water and farmland each have separate energy/settings controls.

Actual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:farming/compatibility)External plants and protected callbacks$()$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/gas_lantern_off)Gas Lantern$()
